current_evidence: The council's Submission requirements page links only this document ('Details of the local list requirements can be found in our validation checklist'); its cover reads 'The Validation of Planning Applications ... Shropshire Council 2022' and a web search found no newer list.

issues.detail: List date 2022-05-01 comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate). The document text gives only the year 2022, with no month or adoption date, so the day/month is unsupported.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'The Validation of Planning Applications' / 'Shropshire Council' / '2022'

issues.detail: Grokbot ignored the document's 24 application-type checklists. It marked Householder '(none)', but checklist 1 lists local requirements: Drainage Assessment, Ecological Assessment and Protected Species Surveys, Roof Plans, Tree Survey/AIA/TPP/AMS, Cross Sectional Drawings, Coal Mining Assessment (in relevant areas), NPPF Sequential and Exception Tests (in relevant areas), and the River Clun information checklist (in relevant area). Checklist 2 (householder + conservation-area demolition) adds Land Contamination, Photomontages, Planning Statement and Method of Demolition Statement.
issues.evidence: Checklist 1 'Householder: works to, or within, the curtilage of a house' - Local Validation Requirements

issues.detail: Outline and Reserved matters are marked '(none)'. Checklists 5 and 6 (outline, some or all matters reserved) and 19 (reserved matters) each list about 27-33 local requirements: Air Quality, Affordable Housing Statement, Drainage, Sequential/Exception Tests, Ecology, ES, FRA, Housing Statement, Land Contamination, Landscape, Lighting, Noise, Odour, Photomontages, Planning Obligations, Planning Statement, Site Waste Management Plan, Statement of Community Involvement, Surface Water Management, Transport Assessment/Travel Plan, Tree Survey, Visual Impact Assessment, Marketing Report, Coal Mining Assessment, Business Plan, Financial Viability Assessment and the River Clun checklist.

Other types with their own checklist are wrongly marked '(none)'. LBC (checklist 10) requires Schedule of Works, detailed plans at not less than 1:20, photographs/photomontages, Structural Survey, Planning Statement, Ecology and the River Clun checklist. Advertisement consent (11) requires Heritage Statement where applicable, a Lighting assessment where illuminated, and photographs. LDC existing (12) requires sworn affidavits, existing plans/site survey and photos; LDC proposed (13) requires Ecology, Heritage, Planning Statement and Tree Survey. s73 removal/variation (20) requires location/block plan, AQA, Ecology, Land contamination, Noise and River Clun. Non-material amendment (23) requires location/block plan and plans/elevations. Prior notification types (14 agricultural building, 15 agricultural road, 16 telecoms, 18 demolition) each have local lists. Demolition in a conservation area (checklists 2/7) requires a Method of Demolition Statement.

Every Full planning row carries 'INFERRED: application type not named', although the document names application types explicitly in each checklist. Some rows are misplaced. 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' (soil survey) comes from the mineral-working notes (checklist 22), not full planning. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is a national requirement for advertisement consent (checklists 9 and 11), placed under Full planning. Minerals is reduced to a single landfill statement, whereas checklist 22 lists Blasting Assessment, Dust Assessment, Land Stability, Soil Handling Strategy, Reclamation/Aftercare plans, Working plan, hydrogeology assessment, etc.
issues.evidence: Checklist 22 'Application for planning permission for mineral working'; soil survey note: 'which affects soil resources must include full details of a soil survey'

issues.detail: Local requirements listed in the Full planning checklist (4) but absent from Grokbot's rows: Completed River Clun information checklist (in the River Clun catchment; Shropshire-specific), Coal Mining Assessment, Affordable Housing Statement and Affordable Housing S106 pro-forma (open-market schemes of 10+ houses in market towns/key centres, 5+ in designated rural areas), Housing Statement, Land Contamination Assessment (incl. landfill gas risk within 250m of a former landfill), Noise Assessment, Odour Assessment, Fume Extraction Details, Landscape Assessment and Landscaping Proposals, Photographs/Photomontages, Planning Statement, Statement of Community Involvement, Surface Water Management (major development), Drainage Assessment, NPPF Sequential and Exception Tests, Visual Impact Assessment, Marketing Report, Financial Viability Assessment, Business Plan, Roof Plans, Cross Sectional Drawings.
issues.evidence: Checklist 4 'Application for full planning permission' - Local Validation Requirements

issues.detail: Several Full planning triggers are checklist headings or boilerplate, not when-required conditions. Block plan's trigger is Planning Portal/contact/phone text and 'What Happens During the Validation Process?'. DAS, Floor plans/Elevations, Highways and Advertisement drawings all reuse 'Local Validation Requirements In addition to the National Validation Requirements the following information may also be required...'. FRA is 'planning fee ... Flood Risk Assessment (if relevant) 43 Explanatory Notes...'; the actual trigger is Flood Zone 2 or 3 including minor development, or over 1 ha in Flood Zone 1.
issues.evidence: Drainage note: FRA required 'in flood zone 2 or 3 including minor development' or over 1 ha in flood zone 1

issues.detail: Mismatched or cut-off triggers. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' uses the Arboricultural Method Statement text. 'Travel Plan' uses the Structural Survey (agricultural conversions) text; the Travel Plan trigger is medium-to-large developments other than private housing. Air Quality ends 'may help define when an AQA is considered necessary: 71', a page number with the criteria lost; the source trigger is adverse impact in a declared AQMA or sensitive development near pollution sources. 'Existing and proposed site levels' is the fragment 'a typical cross section through the building.'. EIA is a definition with no Schedule 1/2 threshold. Planning Obligations includes stray headings 'Open Space 65 Policy Documents'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Travel Plan trigger: 'Transport Plan - Travel Plans, Transport Assessments and Statements 70 Technical Assessments Structural Survey In most cases, before an application for the conversion of any agricultural buildings...'

issues.detail: Nine 'Submission rules' items are process, contact or payment text, not requirements. They are: 'Reduce the likelihood of submitting invalid applications', two sentences describing the Validation Team, the 5-working-day validity target, 'Any monies paid will be refunded...', two phone-number lines, BACS payment instructions, and email/file size limits. The 'Pre-application advice' Full planning row is also advice to seek pre-app on ecology, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: 'By phone - Validation Team (01743 258750)'; 'Please contact the Planning Validation team on 01743 258750 for an up to date list.'

issues.detail: Drawing standards repeats the paper-size rule ('scaled to fit on an A4 or A3 size document' and 'Be scaled to fit on an A3 or A4 size document'). The Validation Team phone number appears in two separate submission-rule items. The HRA text appears both as a tab item and verbatim as a Full planning row.

summary: The link is the current 2022 Shropshire validation checklist, but Grokbot ignored its 24 application-type checklists. It marked Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, LBC, Advertisement, LDC, s73 and NMA as having no local requirements and dumped garbled or boilerplate excerpts under Full planning. It also missed key local items such as the River Clun checklist, Coal Mining Assessment, Affordable Housing statement/pro-forma, Noise, Land Contamination and Statement of Community Involvement.
